description: Renovate proposes every version update as a pull request and merges none of them.

It covers docker/ubuntu/Dockerfile (its base image and syntax image, pinned by tag and digest, and each *_VERSION build arg under a '# renovate:' comment) and the GitHub Actions in .github/workflows (pinned to commit SHAs with the version in a comment).
It also covers the zsh plugins den clones at install: each one's url, release tag and commit in den/_shell.py.
A release becomes an update 7 days after it is published. docker/README.md has the rules.

packageRules.description: The Python versions CI runs (setup-python's python-version) are chosen by hand, as den's Python dependencies are.
